## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/zthewriter/harness-engineering-cookbook/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and put this in the right folder
- [ ] American English, sentence-case headings, second person, a lead-in before every list and table
- [ ] Each recipe keeps "You will have", "Steps", and "How you know it worked"
- [ ] Templates are linked from Context for AI, not copied into this repository
- [ ] Vendor-neutral: no step requires a commercial product. A product is one option, with an alternative beside it, and an affiliation is disclosed.
- [ ] No unverified figures: every number links a primary source or states how it was measured.
- [ ] Links checked: every new link resolves (CI checks this too).
- [ ] No secrets, keys, tokens, real hostnames, or real customer data.
